Subject: RFI: License mapping and model provenance attestation

Jordan —

Thanks for taking this. As part of our vendor review for model governance we need a completed RFI covering: per-model license identification (open-source license type for model weights and tokenizer), provenance (origin repo or upstream provider), version pinning procedures, update/rollback controls, and a software bill-of-materials (SBOM) for any model artifacts you ship.

Attached is our template (Globex_RFI_model_license_template.xlsx). Can you return a completed copy and a CSV mapping for all models listed in Redwood's catalog? Our deadline for initial review is COB 2027-09-17. Also please indicate whether Redwood will provide cryptographic hashes/signatures for model weights and a retention policy for old pinned versions.

If you have questions on scope let me know — Samir

[Attachment: Globex_RFI_model_license_template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-09-14 09:10 -0700
Subject: Draft answers and mapping (internal)

Jordan / Neha —

Attached are our draft deliverables for Globex: a completed RFI spreadsheet (redwood_answer_sheet_v1.xlsx) and a model-to-license CSV (redwood_license_mapping_v1.csv). Key points to call out for the customer response:

- License mapping: We’ve enumerated upstream model sources with SPDX identifiers where available (e.g., MIT, Apache-2.0, CC-BY-4.0, ORT). For models where the upstream license is unclear we flagged "review-required" and included a short provenance note.
- Provenance: For each model we provide upstream repo URL / snapshot tag and the date we ingested the artifact into Redwood.
- Version pinning / updates: Our serving platform allows customers to pin to a specific model version/hash. Default behavior on hosted catalog updates is "opt-in" for upgrades; we only perform automatic fallbacks to earlier pinned versions under explicit customer routing policies. We maintain a retention window of pinned model artifacts for 180 days by default (configurable for Dedicated/Private customers).
- Hashes/signatures: We provide SHA256 hashes for model weight files and a manifest. For customers requiring cryptographic signatures we offer signing via customer KMS integrations (Bring Your Own Key) and can provide signed manifests.
- SBOM: We generate a lightweight SBOM (JSON) for runtime artifacts — we included an example SBOM link in the Drive doc.

Open items for legal review: suggested attestation language and whether we want to commit to per-release signed manifests in the contract.

Attachments: redwood_answer_sheet_v1.xlsx, redwood_license_mapping_v1.csv, example_sbom.json (internal examples)

Marissa
Director, Product Policy — Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@globex.com>
Cc: Globex Legal <legal@globex.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-15 11:45 -0700
Subject: Re: RFI: License mapping and model provenance attestation — Redwood response

Samir —

Please find attached our completed RFI and supporting artifacts. Short summary of what we’ve included (high level):

- redwood_filled_rfi_globex_20270915.xlsx: completed template with per-question answers.
- redwood_license_mapping_v1.csv: CSV with model identifier, upstream source URL, SPDX license, ingest date, and SHA256 weight hash.
- redwood_attestation_letter_20270915.pdf: short attestation describing our process for provenance tracking and pinning policies.

Highlights / clarifications:
- We map upstream license metadata where publicly provided. For models lacking explicit license metadata we’ve documented our provenance notes and flagged for review.
- Customers can pin to specific model versions/hashes; our default retention for pinned artifacts is 180 days for Hosted, can be extended for Dedicated/Private.
- SHA256 hashes are provided by default. If you require signed manifests we can arrange signing via our KMS integration; this is an add-on for hosted customers and standard for Private deployments.
- We included an example SBOM and a Drive folder with full artifact lists: https://drive.google.com/redwood/globex/rfi/20270915

Next steps: please confirm you received the attachments and whether you’d like to schedule a short technical workshop (30–45m) to walk through the mapping and attestation. If Globex requires contract language committing to signed manifests, we’ll route to Legal for a narrow Exhibit.

Attachments:
